string.text: Signed X/Y offsets move the controls as a group. Negative: left/up. Positive: right/down. Zero: native position. Press Apply. Movement stops at the window frame edge; slider ranges can be edited at the top of the patch script.
Range: 0-200 UI units. Default: 72. Zero uses the original position. The label area shrinks to avoid overlapping the dropdown.
Negative moves up; positive moves down. Zero restores the native position. Stops at the window frame edge.
Negative moves left; positive moves right. Zero restores the native position. Stops at the window frame edge.
